title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on good company and wise counsel
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam  highlighting the virtue of good company and wise counsel. The message offers a timeless reminder that wise companionship, noble discourse and selfless friendship are essential foundations for a fulfilling and peaceful life:
"उत्तमैः सह साङ्गत्यं पण्डितैः सह सत्कथाम्‌।
अलुब्धैः सह मित्रत्वं कुर्वाणो नावसीदति॥"
The Prime Minister posted on X:
उत्तमैः सह साङ्गत्यं पण्डितैः सह सत्कथाम्‌।
अलुब्धैः सह मित्रत्वं कुर्वाणो नावसीदति॥
उत्तमैः सह साङ्गत्यं पण्डितैः सह सत्कथाम्‌। अलुब्धैः सह मित्रत्वं कुर्वाणो नावसीदति॥ pic.twitter.com/SCziLeJ7FX — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 25, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/VJ

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X, emphasizing the value of good company, wise discourse, and selfless friendship. The verse states that one who keeps company with the noble, engages in good conversation with the learned, and befriends the unselfish, does not fall into distress.
enrichment.context: This release is part of a recurring practice by the Prime Minister's Office of sharing quotes, verses, and cultural or spiritual messages, often Sanskrit subhashitams or references to Indian scriptures, on social media. These posts typically aim to convey moral or philosophical messages and reflect the government's broader emphasis on promoting India's cultural and linguistic heritage, including Sanskrit as a classical language. Such releases are largely ceremonial or reflective in nature and do not carry policy, legislative, or administrative significance.
